podcast.body: Featured on his 1992 album "The Chronic," this track was a direct diss aimed at Eazy-E after Dr. Dre left N.W.A. Its full title on the CD is "Fuck Wit Dre Day (And Everybody's Celebratin')." This menacing track achieved historic chart success, making it the first rap diss record to reach the pop top 10. "In response, Dre took aim at EZ on the Chronic Track Dre Day, whose full title on the Chronic CD, by the way, is, ehem, fuck with Dre Day and everybody's celebrating."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
